title: Claude Prompts
logline: A user opens a box that is too bright to use, and two companions walk them through the frame that makes it usable, one lit join at a time.
thesis: Raw capability is radiant and overwhelming; scaffolding is one lit join at a time.
note: `eye` names what the eye should find when it is not the emitter (D100: the light pushes, the eye follows); without it the emitter is the eye-trace target. Every story point names what the audience sees change. A pose that does not serve a story point is not a key. Ids are stable: keys, blocking, light and probes reference them. Colour keys name the shot's hue pair from the colour script (creative-spec §Colour script) or a world kit.

state_keys.note: How a story point's `after` keys are read. A key is either a state key of the story point's beat in beats-v2.json (origin beats-v2) or one this file declares for named beats (origin screenplay: the draft's own keys, which no beat of beats-v2.json carries yet). `observe` names the layer that shows it: prop and count read the beat's blocking actors (an actor may carry `on` and `off` frames), actor reads the blocking positions of the figure (the human's root travel `figure.at`), codex, clawd and frame, xsheet reads v3/xsheet.json, light reads v3/light.json, figure reads the figure layer's silhouette (its area, height or width; `edge-gap`: the rightmost ink against the frame's left edge; `centre`: the silhouette's centre against it, `since: previous` from the previous story point's frame) and gates reads the three gate anchors of the blocking. An observe with `world: false` reads the figure itself and asks nothing of the world around it. probe-story.py is the reader.

story_points.action: A closed box. The only light is the seam of its lid. The human stands behind it in the heavy cloak, hands hidden in the sleeves. Codex left, Clawd right, both still.
story_points.sees: poster frame; one emitter; three silhouettes and a box
story_points.measure: lid angle 0; cloak covers both hands; emitter count 1

story_points.action: The human lifts the lid in one move. The sleeves slide back: the first time we see hands. The seam light lags behind the lid, then spills.
story_points.sees: the lid rises; two hands appear; the light widens a beat late
story_points.measure: lid angle from 0 to open; hands visible after, not before; light area grows after the lid, lag ≥ 4 frames

recipes.says: light area grows after the lid, lag ≥ 4 frames

story_points.action: A glass bubble swells out of the box with the gadget dim inside it. Codex, then Clawd, lean in, staggered by four.
story_points.sees: a bubble grows over 40 frames; two heads tilt toward it one after the other
story_points.measure: bubble appears out of the box; gadget present inside; codex lean precedes clawd lean by 4

recipes.says: bubble appears out of the box
codex lean precedes clawd lean by 4

texture: bubble radius grows (the blocking has no scale key on a prop)

story_points.action: The bubble pops. One frame of smear. The light arrives first, the glass second: the gadget stands free with its dial wide.
story_points.turn: the glass is gone; nothing bounds it
story_points.sees: the bubble vanishes; the whole field goes blue
story_points.measure: bubble absent after; field hue area jumps

story_points.action: The gadget projects: stalks shoot up, arches drop in, rings spin out, patches tile, beads scatter, each on twos, staggered. The human turns with joy, arms open: the one full arm-open in the film, and it is earned.
story_points.sees: pieces arrive one after another around the trio; the human spins once
story_points.measure: piece count rises from 0; arrivals staggered ≥ 3 frames until sp-2.3
texture: human turns ≥ 90° (no layer reads the figure's facing)

story_points.action: Nothing is staggered any more; everything arrives at once. Codex catches a piece out of the air. A stalk shoves Clawd sideways. The human pulls the cloak back around and shrinks.
story_points.sees: the human gets smaller in the frame as the pieces get bigger; Clawd is displaced; Codex holds a piece
story_points.measure: human silhouette height falls ≥ 15 %; clawd x moves ≥ 40 px; codex holds a prop; ≥ 6 arrivals on one frame

story_points.action: The human reaches for a stalk to plant it on a patch. Anticipation, action, contact: no pulse. The stalk slides back the way it came.
story_points.sees: a hand closes on a stalk; the stalk returns to where it was
story_points.measure: hand reaches stalk (contact); stalk returns to its start within 20 frames; no seam pulse

recipes.says: stalk returns to its start within 20 frames

story_points.action: Both hands now. The human stacks three patches. They collapse, staggered by three, each a settle with no hold. Codex winces small at frame left.
story_points.sees: three pieces go up, three come down
story_points.measure: three props rise then fall; falls staggered 3; codex holds still
texture: codex boil variant held (a boil variant is the renderer's, no layer records it)

story_points.action: The dial's light is lost in the grain. The human sits down in the mess. Clawd looks at the human, then leaves frame right.
story_points.sees: grain up; the human low; Clawd exits
story_points.measure: grain high; human height at its lowest; clawd absent from frame after

story_points.action: Hold. The human slumped among the fallen pieces, the cloak pooled. Codex small at left. Clawd gone.
story_points.sees: stillness in the mess
story_points.measure: hold 26; no prop moves

story_points.action: Clawd re-enters from the right holding the frame up with both arms. Its interior lights: the crayon world is inside it, refracted. The human's head turns to it first, then the body.
story_points.sees: Clawd carries a lit rectangle in; the human turns
story_points.measure: frame prop enters; emitter sits inside the frame interior

recipes.says: emitter sits inside the frame interior

texture: frame interior is the brightest region (probe-eyetrace reads it on the frames)
human head turn precedes torso by ≥ 4 (no layer records the head and the torso apart)

story_points.action: The human rises. The cloak slides off and falls to a heap that stays. The Swoop is revealed hands first.
story_points.sees: a dark heap on the floor that was not there; a lighter figure
story_points.measure: heap prop on the floor after, absent before; figure silhouette changes garment; heap stays to 1950

recipes.says: heap prop on the floor after, absent before

story_points.action: The human steps toward the frame. Codex, passing, nudges the heap with a foot. It does not move much. That is the gag.
story_points.sees: a step; a small kick; the heap shifts a little
story_points.measure: human x moves toward frame ≥ 60 px; codex contact with heap; heap displacement 4–12 px

recipes.says: human x moves toward frame ≥ 60 px

story_points.action: At the frame. One hand on its edge. The heel taps the floor at its base and settles. The human looks through.
story_points.sees: contact with the frame; a heel tap
story_points.measure: hand within 8 px of frame edge; hold 24

recipes.says: hand within 8 px of frame edge

texture: heel contact 828 settles 836 (no layer records the heel)

story_points.action: The human steps through. The field narrows to the frame; everything outside it dims through the lag. Codex and Clawd follow.
story_points.sees: the figure crosses the frame's plane; the outside goes dark
story_points.measure: human crosses frame x; outside luminance falls ≥ 50 %; next frame's field is paper

story_points.action: A paper field. Crayon architecture: stacked arches as scribbles, stalks as waxy lines. Clawd hands the human a crayon.
story_points.sees: white paper; a crayon changes hands
story_points.measure: field is paper; crayon prop moves from clawd to human

recipes.says: crayon prop moves from clawd to human

story_points.action: The human draws a stalk in the air in three strokes. The strokes stay where they are drawn.
story_points.sees: three lines appear one after another in the air
story_points.measure: three stroke props appear in order; each stroke staggered ≥ 6

recipes.says: three stroke props appear in order

story_points.action: The drawing fills in and becomes a real stalk; its leaf opens. Codex keeps it from drifting off with one hand.
story_points.sees: line becomes fill; a leaf opens; Codex steadies it
story_points.measure: stroke props replaced by a stalk prop; codex contact with stalk

recipes.says: stroke props replaced by a stalk prop

texture: leaf opens over ≥ 8 frames (no layer records a leaf)

story_points.action: The human picks the stalk up and holds it like a lantern. Turns toward the edge of the paper, where the lines begin.
story_points.sees: the piece in hand; a turn to the edge
story_points.measure: stalk prop attached to the human's hand

recipes.says: stalk prop attached to the human's hand

texture: human faces frame right (no layer records the facing)

story_points.action: Everything reduces to pale contour lines, the figures included.
story_points.sees: fills drain; only lines
story_points.measure: fill area falls ≥ 80 %
texture: figure drawn as line (the line figure is a render of its own, `animatic-figline-seq`, with no layer to compare it to)

story_points.action: The lines re-route and connect: the stalk's lines reach the next world's grid. Codex steps past Clawd and takes the lead.
story_points.sees: lines rewire; Codex passes Clawd
story_points.measure: codex x passes clawd x
texture: piece lines connect to grid (the pieces' lines and the grid are not in the blocking)

story_points.action: Shaded architecture with emissive edges. Gates as rings. Codex points to one empty join.
story_points.sees: a dark grid with lit edges; a pointing arm
story_points.measure: field shaded
texture: codex points (arm extended) at the join prop (no layer records Codex's arm)

story_points.action: The human places the stalk against another piece. Contact. The join lights: a seam pulse at the keystone, the first one that has worked.
story_points.sees: a piece set down; a pulse
story_points.measure: stalk prop contact with the join; seam pulse; join emitter lit after

recipes.says: stalk prop contact with the join

texture: the seam pulse follows the contact by ≥ 4 frames

story_points.action: The chain runs down the grid: three gates light in sequence, the third is the one the human made. Clawd watches from the edge.
story_points.sees: three rings light one after another
story_points.measure: three gate props lit in order, staggered ≥ 8

recipes.says: three gate props lit in order, staggered ≥ 8

texture: the third is the human's (no layer records whose gate it is)

story_points.action: The frame stands ahead, now a window with home inside it. The trio steps back through.
story_points.sees: the frame as a window; three figures cross it
story_points.measure: frame prop present
texture: three figures cross its x (the human's crossing is read at sp-4.6; Codex and Clawd's are not recorded for this beat)

story_points.action: Home. The structure stands small under the frame (D102) with the crayon piece and the lit joins inside it. The gadget rests inside, bright but bounded.
story_points.sees: a built thing where the mess was; the heap still on the floor
story_points.measure: structure prop present; gadget inside its bounds; heap prop still present; pieces outside the structure ≤ 2

story_points.action: The human sits on the patch. Codex settles left, Clawd right, each with one idle boil. The frame is set down against the structure.
story_points.sees: three figures come to rest; the frame leans
story_points.measure: human height falls to seated; codex and clawd hold still; frame prop at rest against structure

recipes.says: frame prop at rest against structure

texture: codex and clawd each hold 1 boil variant (a boil variant is the renderer's)

story_points.action: One last look through the frame, now a window. Title. Hold to the end.
story_points.sees: a held picture; the title
story_points.measure: hold ≥ 60; title mark visible
texture: frame 1949 is the second poster (the poster is a still the pipeline takes, not a frame of the film)

asks.question: which object the human draws first
how many gates light
asks.default: three, the third is the one the human made

asks.question: the world kits carry their own hue pairs; does the colour script gain three rows (crayon, line, shaded) or do the worlds keep the kit palettes as they are
asks.default: three rows, taken from the kit studies

themes.name: capability is always seen through glass
themes.invariant: the gadget is visible only inside the bubble or the frame interior; outside both it is lost in grain (beat 3) or resting inside the structure (beat 8); the one stretch it stands free is sp-2.1 to sp-3.1, the overwhelm after the pop
themes.measure: blocking: on every frame where gadget is on, bubble or frame or structure contains its anchor

except.why: the pop: the glass is gone and nothing bounds the light, which is the overwhelm

themes.name: scaffolding is one lit join at a time
themes.invariant: after sp-4.6 no story point lights more than one new join, and the flood (sp-2.2 to sp-2.3) is the only place where arrivals are not staggered
themes.measure: blocking: joins.lit rises by at most 1 per story point in beats 5-8; arrivals staggered >= 3 frames outside sp-2.3

themes.name: light leads composition
themes.invariant: every story point names what its light pushes and the eye finds it
themes.measure: screenplay: eye or emitter on every story point; probe-eyetrace target resolves

themes.name: the human is eyes, Clawd is heart, Codex is humour
themes.invariant: in each act (beats 1-3, beat 4, beats 5-8) at least one story point carries the human's look, one Clawd's touch, one Codex's gag
themes.measure: screenplay: channels field per story point, each act covers eyes, heart, humour

themes.name: details only a child would notice
themes.invariant: every beat carries at least one small persistent detail (the heap that stays, the heel tap, the lid, the hands appearing, the tape on the box)
themes.measure: screenplay: each beat has a story point tagged th-child-detail whose after key or prop persists past the story point

themes.name: warm, playful, inviting; reverent only at beats 4 and 8
themes.invariant: registers outside beats 4 and 8 are warm, playful, inviting, curious, delighted or overwhelmed; reverent appears only in beats 4 and 8
themes.measure: screenplay: register per story point against the beat

themes.name: the frame is the portal: carried in at sp-4.2, never on stage before
themes.invariant: the frame prop is absent from every frame before sp-4.2 and present from sp-4.2 to the end
themes.measure: blocking: frame on >= 690 only; present through 1950
